policy: A row records the final disposition of every generated mechanism after primary-source collision checking, public-asset inspection, and pilot evidence. Merged substudy rows are not independent novelty claims.

candidates.title: 最简但不失真：CooperScene 定向吞吐网络抽象的充分性证书
candidates.reason: No audited primary source provides the same nested CooperScene abstraction-removal ladder, take-level equivalence certificate, workload-transfer boundary, and counterexample contract.
candidates.survivingDelta: Identify the least structured released-trace abstraction that preserves bounded transport estimands, or publish the smallest reproducible counterexample.

candidates.title: 未完成消息不是旧帧：运输可用性状态契约与评测偏差审计
candidates.reason: The exact combination of tagged availability/observability states, one audited completion ledger, censoring, frozen fallback-policy counterfactuals, and verdict/ranking equivalence was not found. Broad deadline/latest-history claims are explicitly ceded to prior work.
closestCollisions: LRCP and other asynchronous compensation methods
candidates.survivingDelta: A CooperScene benchmark-validity contract that isolates fallback semantics under fixed models and inputs, with hard mapping, payload, identity, and prevalence gates.

candidates.title: 吞吐积分驱动的模型载荷完成回放
candidates.reason: Trace-driven replay itself collides with CADET, Harbor, CellReplay, and the CooperScene premise. It remains the shared integrator required by both published candidates.

candidates.title: 吞吐时间结构的最小充分性检验
candidates.reason: Promoted and tightened into trace-structure-sufficiency-certificate with explicit equivalence, finite-release inference, workload calibration, and runtime-payload requirements.

candidates.title: 十二条定向链路的同步吞吐结构审计
candidates.reason: Cross-link correlation is a diagnostic component of the abstraction ladder, not an independent scientific contribution.

candidates.title: MCAP 与 LiDAR 场景时间对齐契约
candidates.reason: The audit found no strict all-frame mapping yet. A complete sidecar is a hard prerequisite for the availability candidate, not a standalone Idea.

candidates.title: 十四个 take 的 trace 发布一致性契约
candidates.reason: All-14 object and schema integrity is a required data-quality layer for both Ideas, but alone is an artifact audit.

candidates.title: 模型载荷归一化后的吞吐完成边界
candidates.reason: Actual and equalized payloads are necessary controls inside both Ideas; payload normalization alone is crowded and does not establish novelty.

candidates.title: 发送与接收方向不可互换性检验
candidates.reason: Direction swaps are a negative control and explanatory substudy inside the sufficiency certificate.

candidates.title: 基于历史吞吐完成概率的截止时间准入
candidates.reason: Deadline-aware scheduling and message admission are already crowded by Harbor, R-ACP, CoInfra, and CooperTrim. The public trace also does not identify packet scheduling or queue service strongly enough for a new policy claim.

candidates.title: 低共降吞吐的协作者组合
candidates.reason: Partner selection and communication-aware collaboration are heavily occupied, while 14 fixed intersection takes do not support a general causal claim about diverse partner portfolios.

candidates.title: 基于完成时刻的历史 LiDAR 特征传播
candidates.reason: Direct functional collision with LRCP, TraF-Align, CoST, CATNet, CoBEVFlow, and other asynchronous feature propagation or compensation methods.

candidates.title: 基于丢包、抖动与实测端到端时延的网络保真度阶梯
candidates.reason: The audited MCAP schema exposes no independent packet loss, jitter, retransmission, or end-to-end latency fields. Inferring them from Vector3 throughput would fabricate evidence.
